def test_urgent_shipment_dispatched_before_normal_for_any_account():
    dispatcher = Dispatcher()
    dispatcher.submit(Shipment("n-1", "north", "normal", 10))
    dispatcher.submit(Shipment("h-1", "harbor", "urgent", 20))
    assert [s.id for s in dispatcher.take_batch()] == ["h-1", "n-1"]


def test_beacon_gets_no_account_promotion_over_service_rank():
    dispatcher = Dispatcher()
    dispatcher.submit(Shipment("b1", "beacon", "low", 10))
    dispatcher.submit(Shipment("n1", "north", "normal", 20))
    dispatcher.submit(Shipment("h1", "harbor", "urgent", 30))
    assert [s.id for s in dispatcher.take_batch()] == ["h1", "n1", "b1"]
EOF
